policy_citations.quote: Revenue codes 0191-0194: Standard billing codes for the four SNF per-diem levels of care referenced in these guidelines: 0191 (skilled nursing), 0192 (rehabilitation therapy), 0193 (sub-acute), 0194 (weanable ventilator management).

system_note: Billed: revenue code 0192 (rehabilitation therapy) for 27 days, 2026-03-10 through 2026-04-06. The facility's own daily skilled nursing progress notes explicitly state that eight dates within this range do NOT meet the documentation threshold for Level 2 (0192) and support only Level 1 (0191): 2026-03-16, 03-18, 03-20, 03-22, 03-25, 03-27, 03-30, 04-01 (see evidence ev1-ev8). The nursing notes state the combined therapy minutes for each of these dates were 90 minutes and explicitly conclude: Combined therapy minutes (90 min) below 120-minute Level 2 (0192) threshold. Level 1 (Rev 0191) billing is supported for this date (NOTE-SNF-medical-records-MR_SNF_03.pdf n224 p.219-220; n226 p.223-224; n228 p.227-228; n230 p.231-232; n233 p.237-238; n235 p.241-242; n238 p.??; n240 p.?? - see evidence mapping below). The facility-authored per-date determinations are dispositive here because the payer-specific guideline for Aetna MA is not available in the dataset and the SNF reference guide teaches to rely on the facility daily-level statement when present (RULE-Policy-Documents-SNF-Reference-Materials-SNF-Level-of-Care-Definitions-and-Reference-Guide.docx-b2/b13). The admission H&P documents a qualifying prior inpatient hospital stay (admitted 03/05/2026, discharged 03/10/2026) and an interdisciplinary plan for skilled PT/OT/SLP (NOTE-SNF-medical-records-MR_SNF_03.pdf-n10 p.8), confirming the overall need for skilled services but not validating Level 2 on the eight disputed dates. Because 8 of the billed 27 days are explicitly documented by the facility as supporting only Level 1 (0191), the billed 0192 line must be adjusted: reduce 0192 days from 27 to 19 and reclassify the eight dates listed above to 0191. Evidence: facility daily notes listing combined minutes and level determinations for each affected date (ev1-ev8) and the SNF reference definition of revenue codes (ev10) and the admission H&P confirming the qualifying hospital stay and skilled services (ev9).
rationale_letter: Re: Audit determination for MR_SNF_03 - Revenue Code 0192 (03/10/2026-04/06/2026) Dear Provider, We reviewed the medical record for patient MR_SNF_03 in relation to the billed SNF per-diem revenue code 0192 for dates of service 03/10/2026 through 04/06/2026 (27 days). The facility's own daily skilled nursing progress notes identify eight specific dates (03/16/2026, 03/18/2026, 03/20/2026, 03/22/2026, 03/25/2026, 03/27/2026, 03/30/2026, and 04/01/2026) where combined therapy minutes were 90 minutes and the facility explicitly documents that these minutes are below the 120-minute threshold for Level 2 (0192) and therefore support only Level 1 (0191) billing on those dates (see nursing progress notes cited below). The admission history/physical documents a qualifying prior inpatient hospital stay and an ordered plan of skilled PT/OT/SLP, which supports that skilled services were appropriate for the stay overall, but does not change the facility's per-date determinations for the eight cited dates. Finding: Documentation does not support Level 2 (0192) on eight dates listed above; those dates are supported only at Level 1 (0191). Correction: reduce billed 0192 days from 27 to 19 and reclassify the eight dates to revenue code 0191. Basis: facility daily progress notes explicitly state Combined therapy minutes (90 min) below 120-minute Level 2 (0192) threshold. Level 1 (Rev 0191) billing is supported for this date (see cited progress notes). Policy context: revenue codes 0191-0194 identify the SNF per-diem levels; facility daily-level statements are the operative per-date documentation when present and identify the appropriate per-diem for that date. Cited records (examples): - SKILLED NURSING PROGRESS NOTE 03/16/2026: Note: Combined therapy minutes (90 min) below 120-minute Level 2 (0192) threshold. Level 1 (Rev 0191) billing is supported for this date. (NOTE-SNF-medical-records-MR_SNF_03.pdf-n224 p.219-220) - SKILLED NURSING PROGRESS NOTE 03/18/2026: Note: Combined therapy minutes (90 min) below 120-minute Level 2 (0192) threshold. Level 1 (Rev 0191) billing is supported for this date. (NOTE-SNF-medical-records-MR_SNF_03.pdf-n226 p.223-224) - Admission H&P documents prior inpatient stay 03/05/2026-03/10/2026 and orders for skilled PT/OT/SLP (NOTE-SNF-medical-records-MR_SNF_03.pdf-n10 p.8). If you disagree with the reclassification for any of the eight dates, please provide contemporaneous documentation that shows the level-of-care criteria for Level 2 were met on those dates (for example, a facility daily note or clinician progress note stating a different combined therapy-minute total or other substantiating skilled need for Level 2). Absent such documentation, the audit adjustment will stand as described above. Sincerely, Clinical Audit Team
